how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_072.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.search.clearSearch.d:
True = GUI clears its search query when opened
False = GUI will display the query when re-opened.
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.apply.desc: Applies all changes and saves configs
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.revert.desc: Reverts all changes just made to configs
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.restore.confi: Pressing Confirm will reset these settings to their defaults. Continue?
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.changelog.des: Lists all changes just made to configs
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.noPerms.desc: You don't have the proper permissions to edit this entry.
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.outOfGame.des: Join a game or connect to a server to edit this entry
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.notLoaded.des: This config hasn't been loaded yet. Joining the game may load it.
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.changes.desc: Change management menu for applying and reverting changes.
Press up or down arrows to change value
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.alert: §o[!]§r - Settings marked with an icon require an action if changed.
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.home.des: Scrolls to the top of the config
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.end.desc: Scrolls to the bottom of the config
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.paste.de: Pastes copy buffer into compatible setting
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.save.des: Saves changes and sends updates to the server
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.back.des: Backs out to the previous config screen
items.lang|fzzy_config|fc.button.info.full_exi: Exits all open config GUIs and saves them, as applicable
items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.announcementsReq: Skill announcements, ceremonies and evolutions only play for players who have the Unique Skill Great Sage. Off (default): everyone gets them. This does not give access to the menu: see requireGreatSage.
items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.requireGreatSage: The G menu, assess mode, voice commands, analyses, the Sage's tips and growth experience need the Unique Skill Great Sage (or Raphael). Off: every player can use them without the skill.
items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.sageInterface.de: The menu, the assess gaze, the voice and analysis. Turn this off and only skill announces and ceremonies remain.
items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.sageShaderRender: On: the menu and every announcement (skills, evolutions, Demon Lord, Harvest Festival...) are drawn by shaders. Off: the classic menu and announcements. Both say and do the same things.
Great Sage starts limited and grows: only intrinsic and common skills can be analysed until you open the rest. Turn this off to have everything unlocked from the start, the way it worked before.
items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.sageReincarnatio: Replaces Tensura's reincarnation screen with the Voice of the World scene. Off gives you the original screen, untouched.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.busy: An analysis is already running. Cancel it first.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.forbid: Analysing that is not allowed in this world.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.noSlot: No thread free. You can run %s at a time.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.notOwn: You do not have that skill yet.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.rankLo: He cannot break down %s skills yet.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.rankSe: %s skills are still sealed: open them in the Growth tree.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.assess.idle: Aim at a target and hold the scan key.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.battle.suspende: %s does not go on cooldown, so battle mode will not recast it. It stays linked, it just will not loop.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.capstone.awaken: True Hero or True Demon Lord
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.capstone.title: It did not yield.
